verdict.rationale: TaxJar's own materials position it as US-focused: 'Built for small and medium-sized businesses that only sell in the US' and AutoFile/filing support is described only for US state tax returns and remittances. The only international element is basic VAT number validation (taxjar-gh-5), with no evidence of OSS/IOSS registration, UK/Canada/Australia GST filing, or foreign threshold tracking.
